scientific_integrity: An exact standalone finite checker determines the mod-two cup form and integral fundamental-orientation behavior. Closed-manifold recognition, integral homology and topological classification are explicitly cited from published literature.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the ordered two-point deleted product of the two-skeleton on exactly seven vertices. It proves a TOP homeomorphism, not a PL or smooth classification; no larger or unordered configurations are treated. Priority may be affected by unindexed literature.
title: The spin deleted-product four-manifold of a simplex two-skeleton
